items.title: Tuya Smart Gateway Siren Smart Home Product
items.shortDescription:
Description
● Based on the design of TUYA smart home platform, it can linkage a variety of TUYA devices for alarm linkage
● High decibel alarm sound, flashing lights and other alarm modes
● Protection at home, out of the protection, removal mode
● Parts low power detection
● System power loss detection
● Demolition inspection
● Built-in battery
● Support Alexa, Google Assistant voice control
● Protection: sound alarm and light alarm
● Home protection: only light alarm
● Dismount: SOS only
● Number of remote controls: 8 pcs
● Number of detectors: 24 pcs
● Volume: high/medium/low adjustable 
● Alarm time: 1-180 seconds adjustable
● Timing control: defense/home defense/removal
● Accessory frequency: 433Mhz (any frequency between 300-912m can be customized)
